model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect of various models across different language families, showcasing the distribution of values for each model within these families. The horizontal axis represents the language families, labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, while the vertical axis is labeled "effect" and ranges from 0 to 30 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each language family is associated with a group of six bars, representing the models mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, distinguished by different colors as indicated in the legend. The bars within each group are ordered consistently according to the legend, and their heights vary across language families, with error bars extending above and below each bar. The values of the bars for the "B2" models (mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2) tend to be higher than those for the "L2" and "R2" models across most language families, with the highest values observed for the IE-Indic family, reaching approximately 23 for mBERT-B2 and 21 for XLM-B2, while the lowest values are seen in the Isolate family, with all models having values close to 0. The bars are not sorted in a specific order across the language families, but within each family, the order is consistent with the legend. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the coloring and legend.
